headline: Iloilo Records 10 Leptospirosis Deaths and 84 Cases Through August 8
seoTitle: Iloilo Records 10 Leptospirosis Deaths, 84 Cases in 2026
seoDescription: Iloilo province recorded 84 leptospirosis cases and 10 deaths from January through August 8, according to the provincial health office.
deck: The provincial health office said Iloilo logged 84 cases from January through August 8, including 10 deaths, and warned residents to avoid contaminated floodwater.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Iloilo province recorded 84 leptospirosis cases from January through August 8, including 10 deaths, the Provincial Health Office said in a Philippine News Agency report published Friday.

Cases were 16 percent lower than the 100 logged in the comparable period last year, but deaths increased from five to 10. The health office said 32 of this year's cases were agriculture-related, pointing to exposure risks beyond urban flooding.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection that can be acquired through water or soil contaminated with the urine of infected animals, especially when the bacteria enter through cuts, abrasions or mucous membranes.

The figures are for Iloilo province, not a combined national or multi-region total. This report corrects the delivery email's unsupported description of 78 hospitalizations across Western Visayas, Central Luzon and Metro Manila.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The rise in deaths despite fewer reported cases underscores the importance of early medical assessment after risky exposure or the onset of symptoms. Farmers, cleanup workers and residents who must cross floodwater can face repeated exposure.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Residents should avoid wading in floodwater where possible, use protective boots and gloves when exposure cannot be avoided, wash exposed skin promptly, and seek medical advice after possible exposure or if symptoms develop.
The Department of Health warns that doxycycline requires a prescription and should not be taken without medical guidance.
